SELECT lt.*, u.real_name AS userName, u.student_no AS studentNo, u.college, u.phone, r.name AS roomName, s.seat_no AS seatNo FROM long_term_seat lt LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = lt.user_id LEFT JOIN study_room r ON r.id = lt.room_id LEFT JOIN seat s ON s.id = lt.seat_id WHERE lt.status = 'ACTIVE'
AND lt.room_id = #{roomId}
AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.seat_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY lt.room_id, s.row_no, s.col_no

SELECT lt.*, u.real_name AS userName, u.student_no AS studentNo, u.college, u.phone, r.name AS roomName, s.seat_no AS seatNo FROM long_term_seat lt LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = lt.user_id LEFT JOIN study_room r ON r.id = lt.room_id LEFT JOIN seat s ON s.id = lt.seat_id WHERE lt.status = 'PENDING'
AND lt.room_id = #{roomId}
AND (u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.student_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR s.seat_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY lt.apply_time ASC, lt.id ASC

SELECT lt.*, u.real_name AS userName, u.student_no AS studentNo, u.college, u.phone, r.name AS roomName, s.seat_no AS seatNo FROM long_term_seat lt LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = lt.user_id LEFT JOIN study_room r ON r.id = lt.room_id LEFT JOIN seat s ON s.id = lt.seat_id WHERE lt.status = 'ACTIVE' AND lt.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1

SELECT lt.*, u.real_name AS userName, u.student_no AS studentNo, r.name AS roomName, s.seat_no AS seatNo FROM long_term_seat lt LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = lt.user_id LEFT JOIN study_room r ON r.id = lt.room_id LEFT JOIN seat s ON s.id = lt.seat_id WHERE lt.status = 'ACTIVE' AND lt.seat_id = #{seatId} LIMIT 1
